body_lead: THIRUVANANTHAPURAM: Opposition leader V D Satheesan has urged the state government to reveal all details related to the Rs 232 crore AI camera project. In a letter to Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan, he alleged that the contract is shrouded in mystery. The opposition leader pointed out that no details on the AI project are available either on the state government website. The project has been under a cloud of suspicion.
